claims.evidence: All 222 RAW files in the file list, each claimed once; non-RAW files (.sne, .kit, .fasta) are search/library outputs, not rows.
Title and protocol: endometrial tissue and plasma; file names carry Plasma_ vs bare/Tissue_.

Protocol: tissue in biological triplicates, plasma in singlets; file suffix _S1/_S2/_S3 only on tissue. Mare ID taken from file name; identical IDs in tissue and plasma assumed to be the same animal (inference).
Title/abstract: mares. Library pools: not available.
Abstract defines control/moderate/severe groups (n=9 each = 27 mares) but 35 mares are deposited and no mare-to-group map is in the deposit or accessible abstract.
Protocol: plasma depleted with Top 14 abundant protein depletion columns.
Files named Tissue_/Plasma_Fractionated_high_ph_library; deposited .kit libraries. Pool composition not stated.
Library file names 'Fractionated_high_ph_library' (45 tissue, 37 plasma fractions); fraction id = S number (contiguous 1..N).
PRIDE instrument field and RAW header strings.
Trypsin/Lys-C mix; column is single-valued in the contract, Lys-C omitted.
Sample protocol: 10 mM TCEP, 40 mM CAA.

limitations: Disease/fibrosis group (control n=9, moderate n=9, severe n=9) could not be assigned: 35 mares deposited vs 27 grouped, full text and supplementary tables paywalled, no mapping in deposit. disease = not available and no factor value column.
Age, breed and developmental stage not stated: not available.
Cleavage agent column is single-valued; Lys-C (MS:1001309) cannot be added, reconcile reports cleavage_agent_incomplete.
Modifications taken from protocol prose, not from search results (.sne Spectronaut archives not downloaded).
